content.title: AI Disclosure Credibility and Corporate Financial Misconduct: Evidence from Green Digital Infrastructure in China
content.abstract: Can green digital infrastructure discipline corporate misconduct, and can discrepancies between corporate AI talk and observable AI action reveal residual financial risk? We address these questions by linking 33,356 firm-year observations for 4,662 Chinese listed firms in 259 cities to the staggered rollout of the National Green Data Center program, enforcement records, annual-report AI disclosures, digital-capital investment, AI patents, audit information, innovation, and city conditions.
